title: PV Power Site Structure
description: Hierarchical structure of the Solcast PV power site resource, used by the /resources/pv_power_site and /resources/pv_power_sites management endpoints.

resource_id.description: Solcast-assigned unique identifier. Used as the key for all subsequent data queries.

name.description: User-defined human-readable label for the site.

location.description: Geographic coordinates of the PV installation.

system_specs.description: Physical PV system specifications influencing model output.

capacity.description: DC array capacity in kilowatts. Primary sizing parameter.

ac_capacity.description: AC inverter capacity in kilowatts. If lower than DC capacity, clipping is modelled.

tilt.description: Panel tilt from horizontal. 0 = flat, 90 = vertical.

azimuth.description: Panel facing direction. 0/360 = north, 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west.

tracking_type.description: Panel mounting and tracking system type.

loss_factor.description: Aggregate system losses (wiring, soiling, degradation). Typical 0.75–0.95.

install_date.description: Physical installation date. Used to model degradation and filter historical data.

timestamps.description: Audit timestamps for the site record.

fields.created_at: ISO 8601 datetime when the site was registered.
fields.updated_at: ISO 8601 datetime of the last modification.

list-response.description: Response envelope from the /resources/pv_power_sites list endpoint.

pv_power_sites.description: Array of PV Power Site objects.

notes: resource_id is assigned by Solcast on site creation — it cannot be user-specified.
Tracking type affects how irradiance is computed — single-axis trackers significantly increase yield.
loss_factor is a global de-rating; site-specific soiling should use the separate soiling endpoints.
PATCH updates only the provided fields; PUT/overwrite replaces all fields.
